name: Tear of the Moons
summary: The Tear of the Moons is a mysterious, radiant crystal unearthed by dwarven excavators at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens. Though prized by the dwarven expedition, it carries a volatile and corruptive power that led directly to obsession, exile, and bloodshed.

sections.title: A Unearthed Relic
sections.body: Discovered during the initial excavations of Bael Modan, the crystal was celebrated as the dig site's first major triumph. Its strange radiance captivated the miners, but none more intensely than Feegly. Claiming the relic gifted him profound strength, Feegly fell under its sway. Fearing the artifact's dark influence—and alarmed by Feegly's increasingly unstable behavior toward his comrades—expedition commander General Twinbraid declared the stone cursed. Twinbraid confiscated the relic, sealed it securely inside his personal strongbox within Bael'dun Keep, and cast Feegly out into the Barrens wasteland.

sections.title: The Price of Obsession
sections.body: Unable to overcome his craving for the crystal's power, the exiled Feegly turns to passing Horde travelers to breach the dwarven fortress and reclaim it from Twinbraid's vault. Upon receiving and rubbing the crystal, Feegly begins to make strange grunting noises. The Tear falls from his hands and shatters on the ground; he then turns into a trogg and dies shortly afterward.

faq.q: Where did the Tear of the Moons come from?
faq.answer: The crystal was unearthed by the dwarven Prospectors and excavators at the archaeological dig site of Bael Modan, situated in the southern reaches of the Barrens.

faq.q: Why was the crystal locked inside Bael'dun Keep?
faq.answer: General Twinbraid recognized the artifact as cursed after Feegly began obsessing over it and turning against his fellow miners. To protect the expedition, Twinbraid locked it away inside his strongbox.

faq.q: What happens when Feegly gets the Tear back?
faq.answer: Feegly eagerly receives the crystal and begins rubbing it. What follows is the ending of his story, described in the spoiler-protected section.

faq.q: Can the Tear of the Moons be saved or repaired?
faq.answer: The relic's ultimate fate is revealed when Feegly receives it. The quest offers no account of anyone repairing it afterward.

angles.text: The tragic fate of Feegly serves as a grim warning of the subterranean horrors and mutating curses the Explorer's League risks waking deep beneath Kalimdor.
Infiltrating Bael'dun Keep to recover the relic strikes a disruptive blow against the Ironforge military presence encroaching on ancestral tauren lands.
